title: GuestImportHeaderShapeDocument
description: guestImportHeaderShapes/{shapeHash}: how often guests.import-list saw a guest-list header layout that no converter recognised (owner decision, 18 Nov 2026), so the next converter is chosen from data. Only a SHA-256 of the sorted, normalised headers and the column count are kept: no header text, no cell values, no caller. Server only.
